Class GroveOledSsd1315

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.grove.display.GroveOledSsd1315
All Implemented Interfaces:
Display
public final class GroveOledSsd1315 extends Object implements Display
Grove 0.96-inch 128×64 yellow/blue OLED with an SSD1315 controller, connected over I2C.

Pass a 1024-byte, caller-owned framebuffer at startup. All drawing and text calls then allocate nothing. The display is monochrome, so Display.BLACK clears pixels and every other Display color lights them. The top 16 pixel rows are physically yellow; the remaining rows are blue.
